author: ABSX Network
description:
DrMysterious Podcast is the mystery podcast that starts right where the explanation runs out. A child’s shoe sits on the top shelf of a bank vault that has not been opened in thirty years. The vault log shows no visitors, so who put it there?

It is a true crime and unsolved mysteries podcast for listeners who want every piece of the case, not just how it ends. You will hear vanishings that left no trace, deaths that never fit the official story, and people who lived for years as someone else.

I’m Juan Santos, and I host this show. I tell each case slowly, the way you would tell a friend at the end of a long night, from the first ordinary moment to the last turn, with the small details that put you right in the room. New episodes come out every Thursday and Sunday at 4 AM.

title: Making Contact: Building an Ops Room Game
author: Tom Constable
description: The podcast behind Contact: Wait Out, an ops room command game.  We're Tom and Ryan, a two-person indie studio trying to make our first game, and this is the whole journey, out loud. The wins, the playtests that fall apart, the things we didn't know we didn't know, and whether two people can actually pull this off.  The game puts you in the chair of an army operations officer in a small patrol base. Your platoon is out on the ground and you are not. Everything you know arrives late and incomplete, over the radio, a drone feed and a sand table you keep up to date by hand. You give the orders. They fight the battle.  Tom did that job for real. Ryan has spent years building military simulation in Unreal Engine. Alongside the build, we talk to people who did the jobs the game asks you to command: what the work was really like, and what a game about it must never get wrong.  New episodes every fortnight. Follow the build and watch the playtests at contactwaitout.com.  Contact: Wait Out is a work of fiction. The theatre, places, units, people and operations in the game are invented.

description:
Horror Stories by Howard Phillips Lovecraft.  
Howard Phillips Lovecraft (August 20, 1890 – March 15, 1937) was an American author of weird fiction and horror, best known for originating the subgenre of cosmic horror, which emphasizes humanity's cosmic insignificance amid indifferent, ancient entities beyond human comprehension.  
Born and raised in Providence, Rhode Island, spending most of his life there, Lovecraft published most of his stories in pulp magazines like Weird Tales during the 1920s and 1930s, achieving little financial success or widespread recognition before his death from intestinal cancer.  
Lovecraft's foundational contributions include the Cthulhu Mythos, a shared fictional universe featuring eldritch beings like Cthulhu, whose 1928 novella The Call of Cthulhu introduced themes of forbidden knowledge and inevitable doom that profoundly shaped modern horror literature and media.4 His narratives often blend pseudoscience, ancient lore, and New England settings to evoke dread, influencing authors from Stephen King to contemporary speculative fiction while pioneering the idea of horror rooted in rationalist despair rather than supernatural morality. 
Despite his literary legacy, Lovecraft's personal correspondence reveals overt racial prejudices, including Anglo-Saxon supremacist views and derogatory statements about immigrants and non-whites, which permeated some of his stories' depictions of degenerate societies and alien "others"—attitudes that, while reflective of early 20th-century nativism, exceeded contemporary norms in intensity and persistence into adulthood.  
These elements have fueled ongoing debates about separating his art from his ideology, with critics noting their basis in primary sources like his extensive letters rather than retrospective projections. 
Stories:
01 - Supernatural Horror in Literature by H. P. Lovecraft.

title: Resonant Writers
author: Resonant Writers
description:
Resonant Writers amplifies emerging poetic voices that confront injustice and imagine new futures.


This series shares community‑rooted conversations and poetry, illuminating how words become tools for resistance, healing, and change.


Grounded in our pillars — Gender, Sexuality, Disabilities, Environment, Justice, and Futures — we trace how poetry moves us toward transformation.


Hosted by Mich, Tayla, and Pep


This podcast has been produced and recorded on the Lands of the Wurundjeri Peoples in Narrm (Melbourne) on the continent of so-called Australia. We acknowledge the Wurundjeri Peoples of the Kulin Nation and pay our deepest respects to Elders past and present. Sovereignty has never been ceded. It always was, and always will be Aboriginal Land.

Hosted on Acast. See acast.com/privacy for more information.

title: Therapy After Dark
author: My Therapy Lounge
description:
🎙️ **THERAPY AFTER DARK | True Crime, Pop Culture & Psychology**
Where true crime meets psychology and pop culture gets psychoanalyzed! Hosted by a psychotherapist, Therapy After Dark explores the psychology behind major headlines, celebrity scandals, high-profile criminal cases, toxic relationships, narcissistic traits, manipulation, and human behavior.
🔴 **LIVE MON–FRI!** Join us for psychological analysis, trending stories, and thought-provoking discussions.
Because behind every headline, there's a human story. And behind every human story, there's psychology.

title: Blue Jean Country Queen
author: kimberlykellymusic
description: Come as you are and get comfortable. I'm Kimberly Kelly- a country singer-songwriter, wife, mom, and storyteller. I talk about life as it happens: music, getting older, wild stories, and also the women (and sometimes men) in and around the music business who make it go round. Sometimes I'll have a guest; sometimes it'll just be me. Life happens, we write and sing about it, and sometimes just talk about it.

description:
Secrets Beneath the SeaHosted by Jackaon MckinneyWhat mysteries are hiding beneath the ocean's surface?Welcome to Secrets Beneath the Sea, an exciting journey into the strange, mysterious, and extraordinary world of our oceans.Join host Jackaon Mckinney as he uncovers fascinating sea creatures, unbelievable underwater discoveries, hidden ocean wonders, and surprising scientific facts that will change the way you see the sea.From enormous underwater waterfalls and glowing ocean waves to mysterious deep-sea creatures, lost shipwrecks, and the darkest corners of the ocean, every episode brings a new adventure filled with curiosity, science, history, and a little humor.Whether you're fascinated by marine life, love discovering unusual facts, or simply enjoy a good mystery, Secrets Beneath the Sea takes you on an unforgettable journey into the blue unknown.Every wave hides a story. title: The Hadal Line
author: Sam Phillips
description:
A science fiction, found footage audiodrama.

Park and Blake are tasked with guiding two corporate employees through a cave system. They trust themselves. They trust the ground beneath them. They don't trust the strange machines their clients bring along.

A few days ago, Andy found a box of cassettes. On them are the final recordings of a failed caving expedition. She recruits her best friend, Jess, to listen to them with her. But as the tapes start, they hear some familiar voices. Their own voices.

title: The Hero's Brake - A Life Lesson
author: Prem Pradeep
description:
What if the most important moment in a disaster is the one nobody notices?
The Hero’s Brake tells one near-accident through five voices: the road, the person who caused the danger, the machine that stopped it, the driver who reacted in time, and the bystanders who saw only the mistake.
No crash. No broken glass. No story.
A quiet parable about attention, blame, and the invisible work of prevention. Because every incident has two stories—the mistake that created the risk, and the intervention that prevented the disaster.

title: Mussar Study · Shaar Habitachon · Rabbi Aryeh Wolbe
author: TORCH
description:
Discover the life-changing power of Bitachon (Trust in Hashem) with Rabbi Aryeh Wolbe in his inspiring Shaar Habitachon Podcast. Drawing from the timeless wisdom of Chovos Halevavos (Duties of the Heart), Rabbi Wolbe explores how developing genuine trust in Hashem can transform our lives, replace anxiety with peace of mind, and strengthen our relationship with our Creator. Through practical insights, relatable examples, and profound Torah wisdom, each episode offers a pathway to greater faith, inner tranquility, and the confidence to face life's challenges knowing that everything is in Hashem's loving hands.

This Podcast is Generously Dedicated by the Butler Family

title: Reason of Ars
author: A-SCI-A
description: Reason of Ars is a division of Reason in Sanctum dedicated to communicating the practices of visual art and music more broadly to society. Drawing on over twenty years of experience from Ace Art Academy—a preparatory school for students aiming to enter art universities in Japan—and from the music-related activities of Smoke Stings Studio, this project reflects on the history and meaning of “creation” and continually offers new perspectives to creative individuals of today and tomorrow. (Podcasts may contain advertisements.)

title: Weekend War Games
author: Aj Akoh | InfraScope Group
description:
Weekend War Games is a podcast about strategy, influence, human nature and institutional behaviour.
Each episode takes an idea tested by history and translates it into the conditions facing modern leaders, organisations and markets.
We examine what survives translation into the here and now, such as:
How does the culture drive behaviour under pressure?
Why do institutions become weaker or stronger over time?
How do enduring principles change when the terrain changes?
Pressure tested by history, translated for today

title: Kyler Hood's DFW Market Brief
author: Kyler Hood DFW Realtor
description:
A 3-minute briefing on the DFW housing market, every Monday through Saturday, from local real estate agent Kyler Hood.
Each episode covers the latest market numbers, mortgage rates, and builder incentives across Dallas-Fort Worth, with extra attention on new construction in Rockwall, Wylie, Rowlett, and Forney. Sourced facts, no hype, no sales pitch.
Kyler Hood, eXp Realty, TX license #828001.

title: The Purple Lantern
author: Glenn Ostlund
description:
In DC’s emotional spectrum, indigo represents compassion. Violet represents love. What happens when the two become one?

The Purple Lantern invites you to become a candidate for a new kind of Lantern.

Inspired by HBO’s Lanterns, each episode is a meditation and another initiation, exploring the story through immersive sound, binaural frequencies, and reflection.

Enter the Dojo of Sound.

Headphones recommended.

Recharge Your Light.

An independent, unofficial podcast. Not affiliated with HBO or DC.

title: The E.L. Podcast
author: dathane
description:
The Enlightened Lifestyle Podcast serves as a living laboratory for the Integral Reciprocal Methodology, bridging outer scientific rigor with inner contemplative practice. Operating under the stance of inquiry before answers, the show explores how to navigate complex, chaordic real-world issues—from alternative economies and self-managing systems like Holacracy to shadow work and political evolution. By combining Critical Inquiry with Mind Inquiry, episodes extract practical wisdom from diverse traditions while setting aside speculative metaphysics. Ultimately, the podcast models a Second Enlightenment, guiding listeners to meet reality with empirical clarity, open-hearted equanimity, and a commitment to collective human flourishing.

I will host EL Discussions on Sundays from 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM on Discord. Hope to see you there.

title: Life With Christ
author: Kierra Marentette
description:
The time for casual Christianity is over.
Life With Christ is a podcast for those who want to walk in love, joy, peace, and holiness—not just talk about it.
Hosted by Kierra Marentette, each episode invites you to live surrendered, anchored in Scripture, and shaped by the Cross.
This isn’t about religion. This is about resurrection.
Live crucified. Live free. Live with Christ.

title: Shaken, Stirred & Slightly Stupid
author: Zachery Traerger
description:
Welcome to Shaken, Stirred & Slightly Stupid, the cocktail podcast where the drinks are mixed with enthusiasm and the instructions are occasionally followed.

Join host Zachery Traerger as he explores classic cocktails, tries his hand at new concoctions and serves up a generous splash of humour along the way. From margaritas and martinis to simple favourites, it’s about learning how to make a decent drink and having a laugh when things don’t quite go to plan.

Whether you’re a budding home bartender, a cocktail enthusiast or simply here for the banter, pull up a chair. Expect drink-making tips, questionable jokes and the occasional moment that leaves everyone wondering what just happened.

A little shaken. A little stirred. Slightly stupid.

description: Daily Meditation Podcast is where you'll find a new guided meditation practice every day. description:

Each episode explores a character word such as perseverance, integrity, trustworthiness, and resilience through stories, reflection, and real-life lessons from the classroom and life experiences.
Brodeurland is built on the belief that character is developed one word, one lesson, and one step at a time.
Follow the Brodeurland Word of the Week series to continue growing in character, confidence, and purpose.

title: From the Book of Kell
author: Kell
description:
Faith. Life. Love. Lessons. And a few plot twists.
From the Book of Kell is where real life meets real faith—with no filter and plenty of personality. We’re talking God, dating, relationships, purpose, growth, and everything in between.
Christian girl. Christian values. Not-so-Christian world.

title: What is Health?
author: Oliver Barnett
description:
After two decades in clinical practice and 25,000+ patients helped, Oliver Barnett has learned that the wellness industry answers this question too quickly and too incompletely.


Oliver is the founder of the London Clinic of Nutrition, a multidisciplinary practitioner spanning functional medicine, naturopathy, and mind-body healing and a relational therapist trained in Internal Family Systems and Terry Real’s Relational Life Therapy.


His conclusion after all of it? You cannot separate the health of your body from the health of your relationships.


What is Health? is the podcast that explores exactly that. Clinically grounded, honest, and deeply human, this is the conversation most practitioners never have.


New episodes on Spotify and Apple Podcasts.

title: The Exam Room by the Physicians Committee
author: cvfr
description: Dive into the science of your diet! Learn how a humble blueberry can fight cancer or what the longest living people in the world are eating. Every episode is packed with facts that will raise your health IQ and boost your nutrition knowledge. "The Weight Loss Champion" Chuck Carroll is joined by Dr. Neal Barnard, a leading voice in nutrition science and founder of The Physicians Committee, and other elite doctors and dietitians. Unlock the secrets to living longer and healthier life and how to fight diseases with every meal.

title: A Zen Mind Guided Meditations
author: bvc
description: Welcome to your personal sanctuary 🤍 Take a deep breath, settle in, and return to the present moment with A Zen Mind Guided Meditations, lovingly created and hosted by Jo Rose. Whether you're new to meditation or have been practicing for years, these sessions are here to support you—meeting you exactly where you are. Each meditation is a gentle space to turn inward, release what no longer serves you, and reconnect with your truest self. Slow down, breathe deeply, and realign with clarity, wisdom, and peace.  *No part of our meditations, scripts, music, or voiceovers are generated using AI. We believe in creating for humans, by humans. :)

title: Cue and Do!
author: Camila and James
description:
Why start a parenting podcast when we’ve only just become parents? 😂
Because apparently becoming first-time parents gave us a LOT to talk about.
We’re Camila and James, and Cue & Do is basically the conversations we’re already having at home as we try to figure out this whole parenting thing.
We research, question everything, try things, change our minds, compare different sources, science, medicine, traditions, cultures, and what parents have done for generations… and then see what actually works for us and our baby.
Sometimes we agree. Sometimes we don’t. Sometimes we’re convinced we figured something out… and the next day our baby changes the plan completely. 😂
We’re definitely not experts, and we’re not here to tell anyone how to parent.
We’re just two first-time parents learning in real time and bringing you along for the journey. 🤍

author: Eric James Erb
description:
Your weekly look at technology, AI, and the digital world Tech World News covers
Breaking tech news, emerging AI developments, and the latest digital trends,

description: The Girl Just Heal Podcast is a safe space for women to heal, grow, and evolve into the best versions of themselves. Welcome to the place where your growth is celebrated, you are seen and heard, and your potential is limitless. Let’s heal, grow, and evolve together. 🌸

description: Welcome to The OCD Stories, hosted by Stuart Ralph. The podcast has been heard over 8million times globally. Check out your first episode from our existing hundreds of episodes featuring experts, and people experiencing symptoms just like you today. If you do, you may just feel understood, heard and possibly help you identify your next step in your own personal journey to healing.  Disclaimer - this podcast is not a replacement for therapy. Please seek treatment from a licensed mental health professional.

author: Stephanie Thompson and Angelina Dickerman
description: We live in a world redefining womanhood, and that confusion is showing up in our homes, marriages, and hearts. Hosted by sisters Stephanie and Angelina, The Pursuing Womanhood Podcast digs into what it actually looks like to live as a Biblical woman—not trapped by insecurity and doubt, but empowered by the Holy Spirit to live with faithfulness, purpose, and strength. We believe that when women pursue it, the purpose we find anchors our lives and the joy we choose deepens our relationships. Biblical womanhood isn't an oppressed role. It's a life-giving one. Come run the race with us.

Once Upon a Shine is a podcast for younger generations - and the younger selves still inside all of us. ✨
Through real stories and honest conversations, we explore the moments, chapters, characters and plot twists that shape us - and the things we wish we’d known sooner.
It’s about self-belief, confidence, kindness and finding your own way without comparing your light to anyone else’s.
Guests share what they’d tell their younger self if they could go back in time and help them shine - passing that light forward, because the right story at the right time can make a difference. 💫

title: OvaryActive
author: mbvn
description: Two gynecologists walk into a recording studio.  Sounds like the start of a joke, and frankly, perimenopause can feel like the start of a joke too. Only this joke is on you. And it's not that funny. But back to those two OB/GYNS….  Dr Rebecca Dunsmoor-Su and Dr. Amy Voedisch have been caring for the reproductive health of those born with uteruses for a while now. And the doctors are frankly pretty tired of how those body bits — and the people they belong to — get ignored by medical science when they are no longer ideal baby-makers.  Half of a woman's life comes after her Build a Baby shop shuts down; however, the medical community does little to educate her about or treat her for issues related to her peri- and post-menopausal body.  In this smart, funny, incredibly informed, wonderfully irreverent podcast, Doctors Rebecca and Amy give us the down low on our… down lows. What is perimenopause? What can I expect? How can I feel better? And for crying out loud, WHEN IS IT OVER?  Tune in on the 2nd and 4th Thursday of each month to get the real information without the hype, the sales, the myths, superstitions, and nonsense. Are your ovaries starting to overreact? Grab a partner, a buddy, a random woman who looks on the verge of tears, and listen up. You're not in this alone.  And as the docs say, "You're not crazy. This is actually happening."

title: The Daniel Cole Podcast
author: The Daniel Cole Podcast
description:
The Daniel Cole Podcast
What if the things we believe, the choices we make, and the lives we build deserve a second look?
The Daniel Cole Podcast explores the ideas that shape how we think, live, lead, and make sense of the world around us. From psychology and personal development to leadership, faith, technology, relationships, creativity, and the contradictions of modern life, Daniel Cole brings thoughtful questions and fresh perspectives to conversations that matter.
This isn't a podcast about having all the answers. It's about asking better questions.

title: The Daniel effect
author: Daniel Rotimi
description: Welcome to The Daniel Effect, where Daniel Rotimi sits down with entrepreneurs, industry leaders, and changemakers to explore business, leadership, health, and personal growth. Each episode delivers inspiring stories and practical insights to help you grow and make an impact.

title: Recovery Elevator
author: cdf
description: It's not a NO to alcohol — it's a YES to a better life! Bestselling author Paul Churchill interviews people who have successfully quit drinking, offering an honest, uplifting look at what an alcohol-free life can really look like. Each week, Recovery Elevator explores sobriety from fresh perspectives — no judgment, no lectures, just real stories from real people. Whether you're sober curious, newly sober, supporting a loved one, or already thriving in recovery, you've found your community.  Topics include: how to stop drinking alcohol, alcohol addiction and dependency, whether moderate drinking actually works, what happens to your brain when you quit drinking, the role of spirituality in recovery, whether AA is right for you, tracking sobriety milestones, and whether addiction might be trying to tell you something.  If alcohol is making you sick and tired, Recovery Elevator is your invitation to explore what life on the other side looks like — through candid conversations and inspiring guest stories.

title: The Mack Exchange Podcast

description:
Formerly the Return of the Mack podcast, former Austin, Texas radio producer and personality J-Mack (the Beat 104.3, Jammin' 105.9 and 96.7 Kiss FM), brings current events, culture, sports, entertainment, and everyday life to the table for honest conversation, fresh perspective, unique insight and a few laughs along the way. The Mack Exchange — the news, the noise, and what we really need to talk about.

title: Wise Traditions
author: mju
description: The Weston A. Price Foundation's Wise Traditions podcast is for those who seek optimal health grounded in traditional wisdom. We believe that vibrant health cannot be cultivated in a lab, engineered through modern technology or found by "improving" nature. On the contrary, "Life in all its fullness is Mother Nature obeyed," as Dr. Weston A. Price observed. By learning from healthy societies of the past, we can rediscover how to live healthier lives today. Host and producer Kendall Nelson interviews leading experts on a wide range of topics—ranging from preparing traditional foods, nutrient-dense diets, organ meats and animal fats to grass-based farming, natural detoxification, the power of sunshine and mitigating EMFs. description: Our mission is to teach women about how their bodies change during the perimenopausal period (and onwards) so they can finally reach their health and fitness goals, live a life full of vitality and feel in CONTROL and at home in their bodies again! Designed to build your confidence, our short, easy-to-understand episodes make investing approachable- so you can make the most of your money. author: investigatorbj
description: In this powerful episode of Conquerors In Christ Radio, Mild Bill shares the deeply personal story of how faith, family, and purpose fueled his recovery after a devastating accident. Discover how God placed memories and experiences with his sons into his life years before he knew he would need them as motivation to keep fighting. Through rehabilitation, perseverance, and unwavering trust in God’s plan, Bill reveals how those cherished moments became a source of hope, strength, and determination. This is a testimony of preparation, restoration, and the faithfulness of a God who always knows what we will need before we do.

title: Global Health Pursuit
author: Hetal Baman
description: Why are infants still dying from preventable causes? How do national security policies impact the health of immigrants and refugees? What is voluntourism and can it harm the communities we intend to serve? The field of global health is vast, and the challenges can feel overwhelming. But learning about it shouldn’t be. Whether you're taking the first steps in the field of global health, a seasoned public health professional,  or simply seeking inspiration from the stories of remarkable leaders, this podcast is for you. Discover how inspiring leaders are combating global poverty, bringing clean water to remote villages, expanding healthcare access, and much more. Hosted by engineer turned social impact storyteller, Hetal Baman, Global Health Pursuit tackles these tough questions with a beginner's mindset. Join us every Tuesday for new episodes!

title: The Mickey Mouse Theater of the Air
author: Golden Replay
description: The Mickey Mouse Theater of the Air was a 1938 musical-variety radio series for children, sponsored by Pepsodent and heard on NBC on Sunday afternoons, featuring Mickey Mouse and other characters from Walt Disney cartoons.

title: The Elephant in the Room: Ben Affleck, Netflix, and the Curious Case of Animals
author: CWEB
description:
A kidnapping thriller, a mayoral race, and the AI controversy nobody saw coming.
Welcome back to the C WEB podcast. Ben Affleck has returned to the director’s chair with Animals, a crime thriller that has landed on Netflix with all the subtlety of a sledgehammer wrapped in a silk scarf. It arrives trailing a curious set of contradictions: a star-studded cast, a director with something to prove, a script he co-wrote, and a controversy about artificial intelligence that has proved rather more interesting than the film itself.

title: The Outpost
author: Eric Pearson
description:
Every great outdoor story has a part nobody told you.

The Outpost finds it. A boot sole that changed climbing. A yak ranch that became a race. A mountain that started in a van. Real people. Real dates. One small thing sets off the next, and the next, until you are staring at something enormous.

Each episode opens in a physical moment, follows the chain of consequences, and ends on a line that changes how you see the whole story. Short sentences. No filler. No lecture.


Narrative journalism from the backcountry and the world that touches it, built on named, documented sources. Roosevelt in the Badlands. Walter Bonatti on K2. The people and the decisions behind the places you thought you knew.

Print edition and more at ridehikeroam.com

title: Wairua & Waffles
author: iHeartRadio NZ
description:
A funny, honest Māori-led podcast about trying - and often failing - to care for our wairua in a world obsessed with wellness.
Hosts Kristina Cavit (founder of The Kindness Institute), Brady Polkinghorne (Māori mindfulness nerd), and Te Aorangi Morini (22-year-old kura grad) explore what it actually means to be “well” without buying into wellness bullshit.
Three unlikely best mates bring mātauranga Māori and Western wellbeing into the same conversation - questioning what we’ve been taught and what actually works in real life. Along the way, they share their own wellbeing fails, questionable fads, and the things they’ve learned from years of working alongside rangatahi and whānau across Aotearoa.
New episodes out every Monday.

title: The RW Podcast
author: Ryan White (RW)
description:
The RW Podcast is a weekly show dedicated to authentic storytelling, bold ideas, and the kind of conversations that make you think. Whether we're interviewing entrepreneurs, creatives, or everyday people with extraordinary stories — we go deep.
Every episode is crafted to leave you inspired, challenged, and hungry for more.

title: DonTheDeveloper Podcast
author: Don Hansen
description: Helping aspiring developers get jobs and junior developers grow. Raw and unfiltered conversations with industry professionals that dive deep into how developers can find success and growth in their careers.

title: The Art of Being Human: A Humanym Podcast
author: humanym
description:
Every great human skill — empathy, patience, honest feedback — leaves a trace. Each week on The Art of Being Human, Deanna and Lily take one historical letter, piece of art, or human artifact and explore the skill it reveals: where it comes from, and how it grows in us.
Come join the conversation. You may leave with a little more empathy, for the people in your life and for yourself.
A Humanym podcast. Write your own letter at https://humanym.com 
Clips from every episode: youtube.com/@humanym_channel · instagram.com/humanym_channel

title: Scars and Sprints
author: Winnie & Mimi
description:
Real teams. Real challenges. No perfect playbook.
Agile frameworks give us guidance, but real delivery rarely goes exactly to plan.
Scars and Sprints explores the messy, human side of technology delivery through honest conversations with Scrum Masters, Agile practitioners, Product Managers, Delivery Leaders, Engineers, Founders and more.
We share the battle scars, difficult decisions, unexpected challenges, failures and successes behind real delivery experiences.
Real stories. Real people. Real delivery lessons with Winnie & Mimi.

title: Minds that Think Differently: Reframing Neurodivergence Disability and Mental Health
author: Amanda Murphy
description: Minds That Think Differently is a podcast hosted by 16-year-old autistic advocate Amanda Murphy. Drawing on her own lived experiences, Amanda educates listeners about neurodivergence, disability, and mental health while challenging stigma and promoting understanding. This podcast is for everyone, whether you are neurodivergent, suspect you might be, want to support someone else in your life, or just want to learn more. Amanda strives to provide well-researched, accessible, and informative content. Join us in creating a world that better understands and supports people who think differently.

title: Smart Coverage. Real Advice. — The Insurance Podcast from The Jordan Insurance Agency
author: Billy Jordan | The Jordan Insurance Agency
description: Smart Coverage. Real Advice. is the insurance podcast from The Jordan Insurance Agency. In 7–8 minute episodes, licensed insurance agent Billy Jordan and AI host Tanya answer the questions real people ask about Medicare, health insurance, life insurance, and home and auto coverage, in plain English. One question per episode, like how long you have to get new coverage after losing a job, or what to compare before Medicare enrollment. General education, not personalized advice. Voices are AI-generated from scripts written and approved by Billy Jordan. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Medicare or any government agency. Episodes and written guides: thejordaninsuranceagency.com/podcast

title: Ga-Rankuwa Sad Stories😢
author: Thabo Joseph
description:
Ga-Rankuwa Sad Stories 💔 - True Kasi Heartbreak

Real stories from Zone 1 to Zone 16, Mabopane, Soshanguve, Pitori.
Love betrayal, family secrets, township pain that you won't hear anywhere else.

New episode every night at 8PM.
Told with AI voice, written from true kasi experiences.

🔊 Listen on Voucher2Own App and win free airtime.
📩 Send your story: WhatsApp [your number]

⚠️ Content Warning: Some stories contain emotional topics.

#GaRankuwa #Soshanguve #KasiStories #SadStories #SouthAfrica #Pitori

title: Where the Fog Settles
author: Where the Fog Settles
description: Welcome to Where the Fog Settles, where Appalachian folklore, history, and memories come alive. From ghost stories and mountain superstitions to forgotten traditions and the everyday lives of those who came before us, we explore the stories passed down through generations. Pull up a chair, settle in, and listen awhile. Because in these mountains, some stories never really leave us. Until the mountains speak again… Walk gently… Listen to what lingers…

title: Corner Booth Sports
author: Corner Booth Sports
description: Are you sick of the same old ESPN listening to terrible takes from people who hardly know sports and only want views then this is for you. Tune in to hear four friends Nick Mill, Sam, Jake, and 1kJam reacting to breaking news, hot takes, and heated debates. This is Corner Booth Sports.

title: Unscripted Republic
author: Rob Billeaud
description: The Unscripted Republic exposes the political script America has been following for decades—written by parties, reinforced by media, and accepted by voters who deserve better. This podcast digs into the structure behind the spectacle and challenges the assumptions that keep the two‑party system in place.

author: Miguel Alejandro Vargas Pichar
description: Conversaciones en inglés para practicar la pronunciación y entrenar tu oído para los sonidos

title: AFTER trauma
author: AFTER trauma
description:
Welcome to After Trauma!
I'm Marina Tsaloupi and created the After Trauma to host conversations with who have experienced trauma and are using their lived experience to build something meaningful—art, advocacy, businesses, communities, and better lives. We turn our trauma into purpose.
You’re not broken. You still get to become the best version of yourself!

author: aser

description:
El terremoto que hizo desastres en ciudad de México el año 1985

title: Money For Couples with Ramit Sethi
author: dert
description: Get Ramit's new book, Money for Couples at iwt.com/moneyforcouples. From Ramit Sethi, host of Netflix’s ‘How to Get Rich’ and author of NYT bestselling books, ‘I Will Teach You To Be Rich,’ and ‘Money for Couples’…  Imagine listening in on raw, unfiltered conversations with real couples, to explore how money psychology affects their everyday lives. Ramit talks with couples from all walks of life, helping them to get past guilt, resentment, & fighting over purchases, to help them create a shared vision for their Rich Life.  Ramit asks the questions we wish we all could ask, presenting a new philosophy on money: spend extravagantly on the things you love, and cut costs mercilessly on the things you don’t.  Follow Money For Couples on Instagram, YouTube, Facebook, and X to start living your rich life today.  In Money for Couples, Ramit delves into the often-hidden dynamics around money issues in marriage, which can be some of the biggest challenges couples face. Money psychology impacts everything from everyday decisions to long-term dreams, and Ramit's finance coaching sessions with couples offer an eye-opening look into the deeper emotions behind financial choices.  Whether you're wondering how to save for a big goal, how to invest in a shared future, or simply looking to understand personal finance in a relationship better, this podcast delivers practical, actionable insights. Each conversation reveals that money in marriage isn't just about numbers—it's about values, trust, and working together toward a Rich Life that's unique to each couple. Ramit provides a safe space for couples to unpack the beliefs and habits that may hold them back financially, guiding them toward a shared vision for their lives. With humor and empathy, Ramit's finance coaching shows couples that they can learn to save and spend in ways that enhance, rather than hinder, their relationship.  Money for Couples is not only a finance podcast but a journey into what makes a marriage strong, financially and emotionally. Through the lens of personal finance, Ramit provides a blueprint for couples to navigate the challenges of managing money together, offering tools to make confident, aligned choices. So, whether you're a fan of the Ramit Sethi podcast or new to his philosophy, tune in and learn how to save, how to invest, and how to create a financial future with the person you love.  Ramit's unique approach to money psychology helps couples overcome common money issues in marriage, from guilt and resentment over purchases to aligning on long-term financial goals. By exploring real couples' stories, Ramit offers insights into how money mindset affects everyday decisions and bigger life dreams. His finance coaching provides couples with a safe space to unpack their beliefs and habits around spending, saving, and investing.  Rather than focusing solely on the numbers, Ramit emphasizes the importance of values, trust, and working together toward a shared vision for a Rich Life. Couples will learn practical strategies for managing money as a team, from saving for big purchases to building investment portfolios. Ramit's philosophy of "spend extravagantly on the things you love, and cut costs mercilessly on the things you don't" empowers listeners to make financial choices that enhance their relationship.  Money for Couples is an essential listen for any married or committed pair looking to improve their personal finance skills and deepen their emotional connection. Ramit's finance coaching and the real-life stories of the couples he features offer a blueprint for navigating the challenges of money in marriage. Whether you're a long-time listener of Ramit's work or new to his approach, this podcast will transform how you think about spending, saving, and investing as a couple.

title: BigDeal
author: trey
description: You can change your life and make a dent on the world. This podcast uncovers the unfiltered lessons from the smartest minds straight to you, in conversations so honest you feel guilty listening in. We believe the current way of thinking is not working. The average person has become unhappy, unhealthy and financially struggling. You are not that person. This podcast will kick you in the shin with truth and tactics they should have taught us but gatekept. Hosted by Codie Sanchez, entrepreneur, investor and reformed journalist. You are a BigDeal to us.

title: Aspire with Emma Grede
author: dawq
description: Build the life of your dreams and learn from the world’s most successful people.Emma Grede, one of America’s richest self-made women, wants you to make the most of your life. On ‘Aspire with Emma Grede', learn through thought-provoking conversations with some of the most successful and smartest minds on the planet, including goop founder Gwyneth Paltrow, investor, philanthropist and former chair of Starbucks Mellody Hobson and international bestselling author and “On Purpose” podcast host Jay Shetty. Each episode will unpack their habits, philosophy and strategies, covering career advice, well-being, psychology and of course how to win in business. The show offers personal stories, data-driven advice, real-world strategies, and the experience you need, to turn your dreams into reality. Emma Grede is a founding partner and chief product officer of SKIMS and CEO of Good American. She also made history as the first Black woman to serve as an investor on Shark Tank.

title: How I Invest with David Weisburd
author: htyu
description: How I Invest with David Weisburd is a podcast that interviews the world's leading institutional investors. Previous guests include The Ford Foundation, Northwestern University Endowment, CalPERS, Stepstone, and other top limited partners.

title: One On One: The Official Tom Petty Podcast
author: Cup & Nuzzle
description:
Welcome to the first Official Tom Petty & The Heartbreakers podcast. Each week we'll hear one famous guest pick and discuss their favourite song by Tom, share their love for his work and how it still lives with them...


Featuring Brandon Flowers, Brandi Carlile, Tony Hawk, Adam Granduciel, Dhani Harrison, Lucinda Williams, Kevin Morby and Margo Price. Plus contributions from original Tom Petty & The Heartbreakers keyboardist Benmont Tench - hosted by BBC 6 Music's Matt Everitt.

title: TLC – Renaissance of Engineering
author: newboxes
description:
What does it mean to build, lead, innovate and create in a world that is changing faster than ever?
TLC – Thinking, Loving, and Creating is a podcast about the ideas, people and perspectives shaping our future.
We bring together inspiring voices from engineering, technology, business, leadership, science and beyond to explore what lies behind progress — the decisions, failures, ambitions, values and human connections that make it possible.
Because creating something meaningful is never just about technology. It is about curiosity and courage. About thinking critically, listening deeply, tak

title: Jimmy Rodgers' Neighborhood

description: "Number 39, I hear you like to hit..."

title: Alright Hear This
author: Alex Steed + Niko Stratis
description:
In which Niko Stratis and Alex Steed set out to better understand history and culture by granularly examining the careers of iconic bands. Rich in side quests and alleyway explorations, there will be plenty to command the attention and fascination of all listeners — from avowed fans of the band to disinterested parties. 


This is not a song-by-song breakdown of a career. We are talking about the world as it existed around these bands. What informed them, and what they in turn informed. How were they shaped by their culture and how did they shape the culture? It is, in other words, about how these bands explain the world. 


In season one we cover the Beastie Boys.

title: From Underdog to Entrepreneur: Building Dreams with Pat Miller
author: fert
description: Have you ever felt like the outsider?  That you are never the first pick?  That you are always being underestimated or overlooked?  Do you identify with being the underdog?  If you answered yes to any of these questions, welcome to From Underdog to Entrepreneur:  Building Dreams with Pat Miller.  Each week, Pat brings super successful entrepreneurs like herself who can provide the tips and tools to help you win when the chips seemed stacked against you.

title: Project UNWD (Real People. Real Stories.)
author: James Kim
description: You’ve tried everything for the anxiety, the racing thoughts, the overwhelm nobody prepared you for. Project UNWD is real people telling you what actually got them through it.

title: Beyond the Script: Stories Behind Independent Film & Music
author: Alander Pulliam
description: Beyond the Script is the definitive podcast for independent filmmakers, screenwriters, and music creators navigating the exhilarating reality of bringing stories to life. Each week, we sit down with visionary directors, indie composers, and creative pioneers to dissect the creative roadblocks, budget disasters, and unexpected breakthroughs that happen when the original plan gets discarded. Honest, craft-focused, and unapologetically real, this is where you learn how masterworks are forged from awkward rough cuts.

title: Real Stories. Real Life.
author: Real Stories. Real Life. by Krupa Suthar
description:
Limited Series: Paths to Parenthood
South Asian voices 
Honest conversations on Paths to Parenthood
Fertility, IVF, Single Parenthood, Moving on from IVF to adoption and The couple's perspective.

title: A Bit of Optimism
author: baset
description: My career is an accident. It started when I set out to rediscover my passion and reignite a spark I’d lost — and that journey led me to the work I do now.  If you know me from my books or my speaking, you know I’m fascinated by why people do what they do. What makes someone find joy and meaning in their life, or pursue something far greater than themselves?   I started A Bit of Optimism to explore those ideas and expand my own perspective. This podcast is a trove of honest conversations, with people who challenge me, teach me, or simply help me see things in a different way. Some guests are household names, and others you may be meeting for the first time. But each one of them has something to share that can help all of us grow.  So if you’re looking for a spark — some insight, inspiration, or just a reminder that good things are possible — join me on A Bit of Optimism!  Let’s grow together.

title: The Fearless Ninja Podcast
author: The Fearless Ninja
description:
I explore narcissistic abuse, trauma, emotional patterns, nervous system regulation and the journey of rebuilding your life after difficult relationships.
Through honest conversations, practical insights and healing tools, I'm here to help you understand what happened, reconnect with yourself and move forward with greater clarity, confidence and freedom.

title: DecaMillionaire Decoded
author: cawq
description: No fluff. No theory. Just real conversations with real business owners doing real numbers.  Hosted by entrepreneur and exit strategist Justin Goodbread, DecaMillionaire Decoded helps service-based business owners scale past $10 million in enterprise value. Each episode delivers hard-earned strategies, honest insights, and tactical advice from those who have built, scaled, and exited companies at a high level — and from experts who coach them.   Through direct interviews and expert breakdowns, Justin walks listeners through the Relentless Framework: Foundation, Examination, Execution, Exit, and Freedom.   Whether you're already generating 6- to 7-figures or building toward your own 8-figure breakthrough, DecaMillionaire Decoded will help you turn chaos into clarity—and frustration into freedom.  New episodes drop every Monday and Thursday. Subscribe now and start scaling with clarity and confidence.  While all the insights shared are for educational purposes, remember to seek advice from a professional regarding your unique circumstances. DecaMillionaire Decoded is a Financially Simple production.

title: Big Feelings, Calm Families with Joanna Voss
author: Joanna Voss
description: A practical, warm podcast for parents navigating toddler meltdowns and big emotions. Joanna Voss explores what may be happening beneath everyday family flashpoints and offers calm, usable ways to respond, set boundaries, and reconnect. Produced by Edenroot Studios.

title: A Little Knowledge
author: Jackson Connor Joe Monaco
description: Two lifelong friends grab the mic to talk about everything from culture and current events to random facts they half-remember from somewhere. Armed with a little knowledge and a lot of confidence, they break down big topics, small topics, and occasionally topics they probably shouldn't be explaining at all. It's equal parts insight, speculation, and good-natured nonsense.

title: The Prof G Pod with Scott Galloway
author: casder
description: Scott Galloway — bestselling author, professor, entrepreneur — doesn't pull punches on business, tech, culture, or life. New episodes every day of the week.  To resist is futile…  Want to get in touch? Email us at info@profgmedia.com.   Want to be featured on Office Hours? Email us at officehours@profgmedia.com.  Part of the Vox Media Podcast Network.

title: MENA PODCAST: Mosaic: Culture, Stories, and Voices
author: Diana Obeid
description: Mosaic: Culture, Stories, and Voices brings the vibrant cultures, histories, and voices of the MENA region to life. This podcast explores the rich literary traditions, compelling narratives, and evolving identities of the Middle East and North Africa. Each episode features in-depth conversations with authors, scholars, and cultural figures, offering fresh perspectives on literature, history, politics, and daily life.

title: Goosebumps Podcast
author: Goosebumps Podcast
description: Conversations inducing goosebumps. In this show we have two brothers covering all aspects of healing, energy, spirituality, conspiracies, personal power and much more.

title: Tuned In Together
author: Jenn Duncan & Tyler Duncan
description:
Welcome to Tuned In Together, a podcast about staying connected while life keeps changing around you.


We’re Jenn and Tyler Duncan—married, parents, former DINKs, career-shifters, occasional adventurers, and two people who definitely don’t have it all figured out.


Here, we’re talking about the real stuff: marriage, parenting, careers, identity, friendship, money, family, adventure, the lack of adventure, and all the ordinary moments that somehow become the big ones.


Some conversations will be funny. Some will be uncomfortable. Some might make us question why we decided to start a podcast together in the first place. 


We’ll talk about the things couples actually talk about when nobody else is listening—the little annoyances, guilty pleasures, unexpected changes, hard conversations, and the moments that remind us why we chose each other in the first place.


No experts. No perfect marriage. No pretending we have the answers.


Just the Duncs, staying tuned in and figuring it out together.


Come along for the ride.

title: Elowen & Zeth
author: Elowen and Zeth
description: They've been here for thousands of years — walking among us, guiding us, waiting for us to be ready. Elowen and Zeth are not human. They never were. Each week they open the real record: the sightings history tried to bury, the races visiting Earth and the worlds they come from, the hybrids living among us, and what humanity must understand before we can join the galactic community. Hidden in Plain Sight — because the truth was never hidden. We just weren't ready to see it.

title: SoCal Voices
author: Angela Ross
description: SoCal Voices is an award-winning podcast about navigating life in Southern California. Beyond the stunning coastline, great weather, and endless calendar of world-class events and experiences, other realities exist: High cost of living. Soul-crushing commutes. The pressure of hustle culture. The quiet ache for connection and purpose in the middle of all this sprawl. SoCal Voices is your companion through it all. Creator and host Angela Ross explores insightful conversations with guests offering real talk, local wisdom, and honest inspiration to help you navigate life in this one-of-a-kind place. Because Southern California isn’t just a dream. It’s a real place, and you deserve to feel grounded in it. SoCal Voices. Real talk in the land of dreams.

title: Produced: How Reality TV Really Gets Made
author: Ilia Saddler
description:
What really goes on behind the cameras of your favorite reality TV shows? Former reality TV producer and executive Ilia Saddler sits down with the producers, showrunners, casting directors and executives behind iconic reality television to uncover how the shows, unforgettable moments and stars we love actually get made.


The producers have entered the chat.

title: Mono Noir
author: MaTeZZ
description: Crime, mystery, and noir stories told through immersive radio drama. Mono Noir combines dialogue, music, and sound effects to bring its stories to life. Writing, voices, music, sound effects, and artwork are created using AI tools, with human listening, review, and revision shaping the finished episodes.

title: The Unspoken Evidence
author: Crime and Horror
description: The Unspoken Evidence is a captivating podcast that explores hidden truths, untold stories, mysterious events, and the evidence that often goes unnoticed. Every episode takes you on a thought-provoking journey into unanswered questions, unexplained circumstances, and the deeper meaning behind the facts. Through careful investigation, critical thinking, and compelling storytelling, we uncover the details that others overlook and challenge you to look beyond the surface. Because sometimes, the loudest truth is the one that remains unspoken. The Unspoken Evidence — Some truths don't speak, but they still reveal.

title: The QB Room
author: Henry McKenna and Steven Ruiz
description: Focused on NFL quarterbacks, QB Room will analyze and dissect the biggest signal-caller storylines around the league. We'll explain what we saw on film and what we've learned from advanced statistics to give the most up-to-date evaluation.

title: Memphis Grizzlies Weekly
author: Mike Michaelson
description:
A lively weekly show for Memphis Grizzlies fans, bringing together key results, emerging storylines, player news, and thoughtful basketball conversation.


Hosted on Acast. See acast.com/privacy for more information.

title: Long Odds
author: James
description:
Long Odds is an anthology about crossing blind.


A small, underfunded, secret federal program has found a way into other universes. Nobody can choose the destination, only roughly how different it will be from ours. Teams go in with a case, a cover story, and a budget that cannot survive too many empty-handed trips, hoping to bring home something that helps: a medicine another world bet on, an engine we never built, a road not taken. Getting back to a world they have already visited works about one time in ten.


Every episode is a complete story with its own ending, in the spirit of X Minus One and The Twilight Zone, but not sad all the time. Underneath, slow currents move: relationships grow, people lose patience with each other and with the program, and some of them think it will end badly. Some crossings are wondrous, some are funny, some are quiet, and some go wrong. Episodes where the team does real harm to the world it visited open with a spoken warning.


You can start anywhere. If you keep listening, you will notice more.


Early episodes are single-narrator readings; later episodes are full audio productions with a cast, music, and sound. All voices are synthetic.


Not every crossing goes well.

title: The Next You
author: Uriel
description: The Next You is a podcast about personal growth, everyday struggles, and the small changes that can make a real difference in your life. Through honest conversations about confidence, discipline, mindset, relationships, and finding your direction, we explore what it really means to become a better version of yourself. This isn't about being perfect or having everything figured out. It's about learning from your mistakes, breaking unhelpful habits, and making progress even when life feels difficult. If you're ready to understand yourself better, build healthier routines, and move forward at your own pace, The Next You is here to remind you that your next chapter can start with one small decision

title: Memories and Lessons with Pop
author: Pop
description:
Be Well, Be Kind, Be Peaceful

What can a lifetime of experiences teach us about living a kinder and more peaceful life?

Welcome to Memories and Lessons with Pop, where Pop shares personal stories, life experiences, and the lessons he's learned along the way.

At 88 years young, Pop has spent a lifetime living, loving, raising a family, building a career, making mistakes, overcoming challenges, and discovering what truly matters.

Some of his stories will make you smile. Others may touch your heart, challenge your beliefs, or encourage you to look at life from a different perspective.

And from time to time, Pop will invite guests from all walks of life to share their own memories, experiences, and the lessons they've learned along the way.

These aren't lectures or complicated theories. They're heartfelt reflections on life, relationships, love, kindness, understanding, and finding peace in an often complicated world.

Some episodes are short. Others are longer. Each is simply as long as it needs to be to share a meaningful story or lesson.

There's no advertising, no selling, and no hidden agenda.

Just memories, lessons, and a sincere hope that something you hear might make your day a little brighter, your heart a little lighter, or your life a little more peaceful.

Memories and Lessons with Pop.

Be well, be kind, and be peaceful.

title: The Grateful Artist Podcast
author: Stephanie  Paige
description:
Are you an artist, a writer, a creator of any stripe? A soulster, a seeker, someone passionate to live your heart-centered best? If so, this podcast is for you.

Welcome, we are your hosts – Stephanie Paige, artist and author – and Evan Griffith, author and art gallery owner. We’re two soulsters having fun living our life mission – to share the inspiration we find in the world around us.

Explore with us! Creativity, healing, purpose, and gratitude. Making sh*t happen and vision quests too. This is a space where both laughter and crackling conversation abound.

We connect with inspiring creators and thinkers who share their stories, their struggles, their triumphs, and their insights – reminding us that we are never alone in this epic creative life.

Why hang with us?

Stephanie Paige is a successful artist and author of the book 'The Grateful Artist.' (She also has the voice of an earth-grounded angel :)

Evan Griffith co-founded a dynamic art gallery and has written 5 bookitos: 'Soul Pages,' 'The Seven Promises of Art,' 'It Is Solved by Walking,' 'The Creative Morning Challenge,' and 'Burn Baby Burn.' (His voice ... is more like someone a little too jacked on caffeine.)

We've lived scrappy lives in creative fields – and share your hunger for meaning, for connection, for creation, and for growth.

You have magic in you. We're here to help you spark it.

title: Exponential Learning
author: The Team
description: Humans can absorb multiples more audio content than written. To that end, this podcast is for absorbing as much intelligence as possible as the catch-all for interesting articles, research reports, or podcast summaries. I hope you enjoy the knowledge as much as we do.

title: Louisville Real Estate and Housing Market | Block by Block
author: Winner Realty | Louisville, KY
description: Louisville real estate, one neighborhood at a time. Block by Block, presented by Winner Realty, breaks down the Louisville housing market every month for 18 areas across Jefferson County, Oldham, Shelby, Bullitt, Spencer, Nelson, Hardin and Southern Indiana: homes for sale, what sold, median prices, days on market and months of supply, straight from the MLS, in about three minutes. Buying, selling or investing? Text Winner Realty at (502) 305-8915 or visit thewinnerrealty.com. Free home value: thewinnerrealty.com/home-value. AI-narrated.

title: The Ever Changing Podcast
author: Alexia Grant
description:
Life is ever changing, and so are we.

This is a space for real conversations about life, faith, love, relationships, personal growth, pop culture, and everything in between. From navigating our walk with God and learning life's lessons to girl talk, dating dilemmas, TV show reviews, a little celebrity tea, and the stories you send my way, we're talking about it all.

I'm not here because I have life all figured out. I'm here because I'm learning, growing, evolving, and figuring it out one season at a time—and I want you to feel like you're right here figuring it out with me.

title: Molle Mystery Theatre
author: Old Radio
description:
"Mollé Mystery Theatre" was a popular old-time radio anthology program that focused on mystery and suspense. Here's a breakdown of its key aspects:
  • Run Dates and Networks: The show had a fairly long run, from 1943 to 1954, and aired on multiple networks:
    • NBC: 1943-1948
    • CBS: 1948-1951
    • ABC: 1951-1954
  • Sponsor: It was initially sponsored by Sterling Drugs, specifically for their Mollé Brushless Shaving Cream, which gave the show its distinctive name. When Mollé ceased sponsorship in 1948, the title was often shortened to "Mystery Theater."
  • Format:
    • Anthology: For much of its run, it was an anthology series, presenting a different self-contained mystery or suspense story each week. These stories often featured classic tales from well-known authors and contemporary works, with twists and shocking endings.
    • Host/Annotator: During its NBC run and part of its CBS run, the show featured a host named Geoffrey Barnes, played by Bernard Lenrow. Barnes was described as an "annotator" or "connoisseur of crime" who would help listeners analyze and understand the mysteries.
    • Character Focus: In its later years, particularly on CBS, the format shifted to center around a single character, Inspector Hearthstone (played by Alfred Shirley), and was even titled "Hearthstone of the Death Squad" for a period. On ABC, it became "Inspector Mark Saber of The Homicide Squad" or "Mark Saber Mysteries."
  • Production Quality: "Mollé Mystery Theatre" was known for its high production values, including strong scripts, fine orchestral scores, and performances by talented radio actors, including up-and-coming stars like Richard Widmark and Frank Lovejoy.
  • Legacy: It's considered a significant part of the Golden Age of Radio, offering "spine-tingling plays and stories" that kept audiences on the edge of their seats. Many episodes are still available today as part of old-time radio archives.

Hosted by the team at Parsa Wellness Clinic — with locations in North Vancouver and Chilliwack.

title: Paying Attention
author: Choy Travers
description:
Paying Attention is a podcast about how media, advertising, technology and commerce are being reshaped by AI.
Hosted by Choy Travers, each episode features candid conversations with leaders across publishing, journalism, advertising, brands, adtech and technology; exploring how attention is won, valued and monetised as the internet changes.
Featuring leaders from some of the world’s most influential media and technology companies.

title: The Slingin Podcast
author: Kay Bond
description: The Slingin' Podcast is Hoodz Radio's home for hustle talk — real stories from people who built something out of nothing. Straight talk on the grind, the setbacks, and the come-up, from the block to the boardroom. No scripts, no shortcuts — just game, taught by the ones who lived it. Respect the legacy. Amplify the movement.

author: Liberal Currents
description: An audiobook adaptation of an essay collection produced by Liberal Currents. This collection brings together experts in a number of fields to offer bold visions for a post-Trump, liberal democratic America.

title: Life with Lindy
author: Lindy
description: Live life alongside a 40 year old cancer-surviving, morning news-anchoring boy mom. Lindy Thackston was getting up at 2 a.m. every day to anchor the news and chasing a 4-year-old when she was diagnosed with stage 3 colorectal cancer during the pandemic. In short, easy to listen to podcasts, she details her days and shares her life behind the camera in hopes of giving more people a fighting chance.

title: The Business Law Podcast
author: Jonathan Fleisher
description: A legal podcast with experienced New Jersey Small Business Attorney Jonathan Fleisher. In this podcast, we go through legal concepts that are relevant to small business owners and individuals. Each episode will discuss interesting business topics in a way that simplifies the law for everyday business owners and easy listening.

title: Cantor Opina
author: Sonoro
description: Cantor Opina es el lugar para ver y vivir el Mundial con la opinión y la pasión de Andrés Cantor. El Hall of Fame del relato deportivo te lleva más allá del resultado: su análisis, su mirada, las historias y la emoción de cada partido de la Copa del Mundo FIFA 2026. description: A safe and cozy space for anxious souls. Each episode brings gentle recommendations from books to curl up with, games to unwind with, and small calming rituals for the hard days.

title: The Living Experiment - Exploring Faith in a Multifaith World
author: Brookville Multifaith Campus
description:
What happens when people of different faiths come together, not to change one another's beliefs, but to listen, learn, and co-exist?

Welcome to "The Living Experiment," hosted by Lorrie, where we believe that living together in understanding isn't just possible, it's essential.

Rooted in the everyday life of New York's Brookville Multifaith Campus, where Christian, Jewish, and Muslim communities worship side by side, we explore faith, spirituality, identity, and what it means to thrive together in an increasingly divided world.

Through heartfelt conversations and interfaith dialogue with faith leaders, interfaith families, public figures, and people from all walks of life, we ask thoughtful questions, share personal stories, and discover what we can learn from one another.

Whether you're deeply rooted in your faith, curious about other traditions, or simply value tolerance, you belong here.

Together, we'll celebrate our differences, embrace what connects us, and discover the possibilities of a more understanding world.


Disclaimer: The religious views and beliefs expressed by interview guests are strictly their own and do not necessarily reflect or represent the values of this podcast or its hosts. We share these conversations to foster cross-cultural understanding, peace, and acceptance, rather than to endorse any specific faith tradition.

© 2026 Brookville Multifaith Campus

title: Floops Festival by DJ Floops

description: Welcome to Foops Festival with DJ Floops—your ultimate destination for high-energy Chutney Soca, Caribbean vibes, and non-stop festival anthems. Packed with seamless transitions, exclusive dubs, and heavy-hitting rhythms, each episode delivers a front-row festival experience straight to your speakers. Turn it up, feel the bass, and let the session take over.

title: K-Pop Unfiltered - The Seoul Scoop
author: Peter Jesse
description:
Welcome to The Seoul Scoop, the podcast where we spill the tea on everything happening in the K-Pop industry. Whether you're a multi-stan, a dedicated fandom member, or just casually trying to figure out what a "bias wrecker" is, we've got you covered.

Every week, we dive into:

  • The Comebacks: Honest reviews of the latest music videos, album drops, and concept photos.
  • The News: Chart updates, agency announcements, tour dates, and who is charting where.
  • The Drama: We untangle the rumors, the dating scandals, the Twitter (X) fan wars, and the agency disputes so you don't have to.

Get ready for deep dives, hot takes, and a lot of screaming over our favorites. New episodes drop every Monday!

title: The Breakthrough Moment Podcast
author: Zac Deane
description:
What’s the moment that changed everything?


Join Zac Deane on The Breakthrough Moment Podcast for honest conversations with entrepreneurs, investors and professionals about the turning points that shaped their lives and careers.


Go beyond the achievements to explore the setbacks, difficult decisions and personal transformations behind them. Each episode uncovers what changed, what it took to move forward and the lessons listeners can bring into their own lives.


Having rebuilt after business and personal setbacks, Zac brings curiosity and lived experience to conversations about entrepreneurship, purpose, resilience and growth.


Whether you’re building a business, navigating change or wondering what comes next, these stories offer fresh perspectives and the encouragement to take your next step.


Someone else’s breakthrough could be the beginning of yours.


Discover more at zacdeane.com.

title: Held with Farah Orths
author: Farah Orths
description:
A podcast in devotion to this sacred Life that holds us in it's arms. We explore what it means to live with Divine Love as our guide through it all, opening to unconditional receiving, and the miracle of being alive. Join Farah for sacred conversations, solo episodes and featured guests, that awaken the remembrance of being held by Love itself throughout all seasons. 
Farah Orths is a Hay House Author, channel, ceremonialist, and musician who brings the unconditional love of the Divine into the human realm as an awakening force of healing and invites coming home through radical softening.

title: Vow Much?!
author: Craig Priest
description:
💍 Vow Much? — Love, Laughs & Weddings done YOUR way 🎙️


Who says your dream wedding has to cost a fortune? Who says you have to have three course meals and fancy cars?


We're Craig & Nat Priest, two big kids at heart who said “I do” to each other, but a big fat “NO THANK YOU!” to the eye-watering price tags, endless expectations and the idea that there's only one way to get married!


Welcome to Vow Much — our wedding documentary, diary and honest account of how we pulled together our wedding and party in just three months, on a super-tight budget, and entirely our way.


We're here to share the chaos, the laughs, the lessons learned and the moments that made it all worthwhile. Whether you're planning your own wedding, drowning in costs and decisions, or just fancy a peek behind the scenes of two newlyweds figuring it all out, we've got stories to tell and advice to share.


No judgement. No pressure. No “you HAVE to do it this way.” We know the traditional wedding is perfect for some couples — and that's absolutely fine! It just wasn't for us. ❤️


Part love story, part planning diary, part “what on earth are we doing?!”, Vow Much is our way of capturing the memories for years to come and hopefully helping other couples realise that your wedding doesn't have to follow the rules to be unforgettable.


We're married, we're still silly, and we're legally committed to putting up with each other. What could possibly go wrong?


Your wedding. Your rules. Your budget. Your way.
